mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5% in the month preceding the prediction is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 forward return due to reduced risk-free discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the tightening phase (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not cross the 5% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as lower expected labor cost growth supports corporate valuation expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with UNRATE changes (R² < 0.05), or UNRATE remains below 4% throughout the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly HOUST (household spending) exceeds 1,300 (in thousands of units) while INDPRO remains flat, the S&P 500 is expected to post positive 20-day forward returns as demand outpaces supply.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1300 and INDPRO unchanged in the current month
regime_hint: Resilient consumer demand with steady production
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the signal, or INDPRO shows a significant upward movement that negates the demand outpacing supply condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in GDPC1 (real private consumption) of at least 2% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as market anticipates weaker future earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10), or GDPC1 growth is not below -2% in the quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to show positive 20-day forward returns as markets price in accommodative policy and lower risk premia.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10), or FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in PAYEMS (employment) of more than 10,000 coinciding with a rise in UNRATE above 4.5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days due to labor market weakness and higher discounting.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < previous month by >10,000 and UNRATE > 4.5% in the current month
regime_hint: Labor market softening with rising unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or employment does not fall sufficiently while UNRATE remains high.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO exceeds 105 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months while HOUST remains flat, the S&P 500 is expected to show a positive 20-day forward return as supply expansion is muted.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 105 and HOUST unchanged for the past 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10), or INDPRO does not remain elevated while HOUST is flat.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in RSAFS (reserves) relative to GDP proxy (GDPC1) in the prior month signals liquidity stress and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio falls by >5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10), or the RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio does not fall sharply.
